notes.title: Extra XP from Customer Reviews and Online Orders
notes.content:
[h1]1- Extra XP from Customer Reviews[/h1][p]100% increase![/p][p]As you know, you get extra level points if you complete a day with more than 4 points.[/p][p]Here are the updated numbers:[/p][list][*][p][i]If your review score is 4.00, you get 20 level points instead of 10 level points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]If you're above 4.00, you get more level points (20+). The higher the review score, the higher the level points.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]If your review score is 5.00, you get 50 level points instead of 25 level points.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]You can see how many level points you earn in the daily report.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/86265b9b86a686e54cf7c96a216c9e11dd1838ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder:[/p][p]You can check your current score from the Desktop-Customer Reviews.[/p][p][u]How to increase customer satisfaction?[/u][/p][p]* Avoid long checkout queues
* Keep the store clean
* Set product prices by considering the recommended prices
* Let your customers find all products in the store racks
* Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
* Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7d82475d6e6b5ee36499dd90567e21eb2281821d.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]2- Extra XP from Online Orders[/h1][p]Each completed online order brings 20 level points instead of 15.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b140d2f66cd148f8995b12558ef6ed404ce879a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]3- Business Tycoon is removed from the shopping bags[/h1][p]Now there is nothing written on the shopping bags, but your store logo is still there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/fb068b71ddc558a0c00c9e8a3097a3c59ffe7cf6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h2]Sporting Goods Shop is now available in Early Access![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3653250/Sporting_Goods_Shop/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v[0.1.030] Object Snapping, New Walls, New Floors
notes.content:
[h1]1- Object Snapping[/h1]

You can use the object snapping feature while placing store racks, warehouse racks, decorations, cash registers, and speakers.
[i](You can disable it in the Options - Gameplay settings.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/e741525ad2256136358754f6e9d8a5350d73dfa9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/3905b0ad154147b6d9280ae5d8f2dd72517166f3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a2b5e28c7601637083e270ea98e95008ad8e1ce3.jpg[/img]

[u]If you want to use the object snapping feature on wall racks, you should know that they are only functional with other wall racks.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/c50bf717975872e3761b2915b8113023ac24684a.jpg[/img]

[u]Align Snapping Objects[/u]
If you "Hold Left Shift (by default)" while placing an object, you can align the object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2b7e7c7cbffbe209363bac049334372571477ecd.jpg[/img]

(It's Left Shift by default, but you can change it in the Options-Controls.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b3f6d72bf9b49972e6ca5df37782bf8080f4dcb6.jpg[/img]

If you don't want to use the object snapping feature, you can disable it in the Options - Gameplay settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/47012de4e3b07c12fdd7b6996490957767b8db35.jpg[/img]

[h1]2- New Walls[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a3586df2cf5da4894123285f421f185bc3643038.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/f4b8370e9c256b24704efc9cbaab9d14b87ebfcc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/1c4098e2ef4c316a787a79d1b0f281650ef99457.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/618761cd22431fa5139bb6942d80fcee3a474495.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2a693c372be1d254953b1b239b3180b175142067.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/505d8fea4bea5a93b14e6b136a1add4b4b363a5d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/4408bee1036fbf95bf8e8090af5e87e08f04a3ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2e763944e89e58ebe612d483a6a6cadadee9b114.png[/img][/url]

[h1]3- New Floors[/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/8d5b7ba3104138d4933378658bb5c6417eedcd86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/93c2cbc82dc1cc1de68ad7f571c12198a8206e53.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2df0c2e1eb7250471a6d4bb9a513e9acea6998a6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/46256dc8707ea1797591801d4d1f187dfc2493d4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/f48d09a607359fa385efdcaf8a7a932e00f85f62.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/96230e57595ce4eb4ac06fa984eea5338b690d91.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/8368b936f6d3b42c63a94a112f8c5e177ada8e85.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/8676285494321ee4ec6dd49bb9db9563a00ec582.png[/img][/url]

Now there are two new buttons on the Main Menu: "Single Player" and "Multiplayer".
[i]You can switch your "Single Player" game mode to the "Online Co-op" mode while loading your save file anytime.[/i]

"Thief" and "Cleaning" can be turned on or off just before you start a new game or before you load a save file.

notes.title: v[0.1.024] New Shortcut - Add to Cart
notes.content:
[h1]New Shortcut - Add to Cart[/h1]
You can add any product to your shopping cart using the T-key (by default).
There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:
* When you hover on a store rack
* When you hover on an empty store rack (but tagged with a product)
* When you hover on a warehouse rack spot.
* When you hover on an empty warehouse rack spot (but tagged with a product).
* When you hover on a box on the ground

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/1826781d77be7752e143a65d0e9a47c48620dfbc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2235f40892b7d53f173577c35ea85f0cd9e4c66c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v[0.1.023] New Shortcut - Check Inventory
notes.content:
[h1]1- New Shortcut - Check Inventory[/h1]

You can hold the Z-key (by default) to check your inventory.
When you hold the Z-key (by default), you can see how many products are in your store and how many products are in your stock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ee5b1c661be07dae9ec485e6e2fea386fc593c28.jpg[/img]
[i]As you can see in the screenshot:
* There are 24 products on the store racks.
* This product's tagged store racks are for a capacity of 30 products
* There are 45 products in your stock.[/i]

[b]It's Z-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.
Keybinding:  Options -> Controls -> Check Inventory[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/96464522e432adcaca36a0ae052117e3fadacaac.jpg[/img]

[b]There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:[/b]
[u]1- You can check your inventory when you hover on a store rack.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/770e02d41d7359ddef13ef9eda9486a44397ac03.jpg[/img]

[u]2- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty store rack (but tagged with a product).[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/8be845639ed7bccd46ee8230cc508b9e17e4717e.jpg[/img]

[u]3- You can check your inventory when you hover on a warehouse rack spot.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ebfadfe3077f4a01ef70ede69f8fe128bf44557d.jpg[/img]

[u]4- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty warehouse rack spot (but tagged with a product).[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/3787d348a354c8c65d89e50019c6addb28eeba89.jpg[/img]

[u]5- You can check your inventory when you hover on a box on the ground.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/9f4dfe119e3abfce23ef5c466ee8a718215aa074.jpg[/img]

[h1]2- New Warning: No product in a market category[/h1]
There is a new warning for someone having trouble with signing the first contract.
[list]
[*]If there is no product in a market category, it means that you haven't signed any contract in that category yet.
[*]If there is no product in the market section at all, it means that you haven't signed any contract yet.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b55a7caa353b6211b13c20f15c710209ab4c25f5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v[0.1.018] Customer Review Score
notes.content:
[h1]Customer Review Score[/h1]
Customers rate your store during the checkout process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/507affcfecc02fe451854b026241a6ced15be3f3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a419ef7ffa4dc1c8b26a016dd1ce41a11b62d942.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/2510822280a335eed2aa516c74fc07177b481a3a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/92ef519b4fea0b77b6380ca4a17733e442c4a39f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/6e43fe0c57447387f6efffcac4dfbe30173d553a.png[/img]

[u][h3]You get extra level points if you complete a day with higher than 4 points.[/h3][/u]
[i]If your review score is 4.00, you get 10 level points.
If you're above 4.00, you get more level points (10+). The higher the review score, the higher the level points.
If your review score is 5.00, you get 25 level points.[/i]
You can see how many level points you earn in the daily report.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/12696330035af29a910c7836dfac1d55713439f9.jpg[/img]

You can check your current score on Desktop-Customer Reviews. The current score is today's score. It'll reset at the end of the day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/22051447a6c0f45129265c9d41f1fe9032c1da1a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b6bdce76afa7afd6b83e19635043cb0ad13200af.jpg[/img]

How to increase customer satisfaction?
* Avoid long checkout queues
* Keep the store clean
* Set product prices by considering the recommended prices
* Let your customers find all products in the store racks
* Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
* Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store
